sharedInstructions: Article preparation for https://jas-law-astro-review.netlify.app/ (preserve mode). Classification: /post/<slug>/ URLs carry BlogPosting JSON-LD with full editorial articleBody, noindex meta and an 'In the News'-free 'Posts & Defense Insights' eyebrow; they are blog posts. /media-articles/<slug>/ URLs are press-coverage reprints (sourceName, sourceAuthor, external 'Read the full article here' link, 'Press Coverage' label, Article metadata); they are media articles. /practice-area/<slug>/ URLs are Service/LegalService landing pages with FAQs and CTAs, not individual articles, so they are pages. The site sitemap lists all three families together, so membership alone did not decide the classification; the article metadata did. Collections: src/content.config.ts defines blog (schema: title, description required; pubDate required coerce date; draft, image, imageAlt, featured, toc, jsonLd, etc.), media (title, description required; pubDate, sourceName, sourceAuthor, sourceUrl, sourcePath, image, imageAlt, draft optional) and docs. Do not add another content config. Routes: /post/[slug].astro (new, shared, renders blog entries by entry.id using render(entry) and BlogLayout, mdxFilePath src/content/blog/<id>.mdx); /media-articles/[...slug].astro (existing, renders media entries by entry.id through MediaArticleLayout). Layouts: BlogLayout.astro (data-mdx-type is blog, matching the blog collection, so no variant needed for posts) and MediaArticleLayout.astro (data-mdx-type media). Post entries map original /post/<slug>/ to src/content/blog/<slug>.mdx with id = slug, so the route serves /post/<slug>/. Blog schema has no sourcePath field; the id mapping carries the permalink. Placeholders removed: the eight src/pages/post/*.astro import placeholders and the two src/pages/media-articles placeholder files for the requested press articles, because static files would shadow the dynamic routes. Media entries for the two requested press articles were created in this preparation; other press entries already existed and were not touched. Unresolved: BlogLayout is the generic template layout (max-w-3xl prose article, no source-style 'Posts & Defense Insights' hero or CTA band); entry workers should compare the rendered post with the source and adapt BlogLayout only for post presentation, not for other blog content. Source pages are noindex; the blog schema has no robots field, so this is not reproduced. No blog entries have been written yet; route compiles with an empty blog collection. Date rule: source post dates were not captured; set pubDate from source evidence when available, otherwise use 2026-10-27 and say so in the reply.
